subject: Lena Concierge
tagline: An AI concierge for alpine hotels and rentals that answers guests in their language and books rooms inside the chat, with emergencies kept away from the model.

sources.title: Lena Concierge: the AI concierge for alpine hospitality
Lena Concierge at Web Summit Lisbon 2026 (ALPHA)

what_it_does.text: Lena is a guest-facing chat concierge for alpine hosts, live in Saas-Fee since summer 2026. It answers guests 24/7 in five languages about lifts, weather, restaurants and events, checks live availability in the property's booking system (apaleo) and takes the booking inside the chat; restaurant requests go out by WhatsApp. On 4 October 2026 it reported 962 guest conversations in production and 35 properties connected.

agents.name: Lena (guest concierge)
agents.what: A chat agent that answers from checked facts and books rooms in the property's PMS.
actions: Answers guest questions from separate stores of resort knowledge and property data
Checks live availability in apaleo and makes or cancels bookings inside the chat
Offers Booking.com Demand when the property is full
Sends restaurant table requests by WhatsApp

use_cases.name: A guest books a room at 23:40 with nobody at the desk
use_cases.who: Guests of small alpine hotels and holiday rentals

reach.what: The property's booking system (apaleo): offers, reservations, cancellations
Guest messages in the chat, in five languages
Booking.com Demand, for guests when the property is full

mandate.what: Illustrative: answer from checked facts only; never quote a price for another property.
Illustrative: book or cancel only the guest's own reservation, after the guest confirms.
Illustrative: emergencies answered by fixed text, never by the model.

gap.what: The PMS integration can make and cancel reservations; the page does not say whether a cancellation needs the guest or the host to confirm.

controls.what: Prices and opening hours come from checked facts; "the model chooses the fact and understands the question"
Medical, fire and avalanche emergencies are answered from fixed, tested text; "no model writes that reply"; the owner is notified
"Lena never quotes its own price for somebody else's house"

questions: When Lena cancels a booking in the PMS, who confirms it: the guest, the host, or nobody?
Can a host limit Lena to answering and proposing, with the booking done by a person?
Is there a record per action of what Lena did in the PMS, that the host can export?
